successors.name: Haryanka dynasty
successors.text: 'The Mallas also became part of Ajatashatru's Māgadhī empire'

ledger.x: c. 600 BCE: the Mallas of Kusinārā and Pāvā stand as one of the sixteen Mahajanapadas on the Kushinagar country. Infobox 'Established: c. 7th century BCE', 'Aristocratic Republic'; the Mahajanapadas page has the Mallakas 'originally' a monarchy that 'later ... switched to one of Samgha (republican union)'. -600 is…
468 BCE: Magadha annexes the Vajjika League and the Mallas with it.

wars.name: Magadhan conquest of the Vajjika League
wars.outcome: Ajatashatru 'declared war on the Vajjika League in 484 BCE' and Magadha 'finally defeat[ed] the Vajjika League by 468 BCE and annex[ed] its territories'; the Mallas, members of the League, became part of his empire.

certainty.note: The Sadānirā (Gandak) to the east and the Hiraññavatī between the two republics are the only lines the page gives; the Kosala and Videha frontiers are approximate.
